cases.sentence: Господь пастырь мой, я ни в чем не буду нуждаться в ___.
cases.explain: The phrase 'в чем' uses the prepositional case with в (in).
The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional case.
The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он душу мою оживляет, сердце мое ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb requires the accusative for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Ты приготовил мне пир на виду моих ___.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before, in presence of) takes the genitive case.
The transitive verb умастил (anoint) takes the accusative direct object.
The predicate nominative agrees with the subject in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Благо и милость добудут со мною все дни моей ___.
cases.explain: The word дни (days) in the meaning 'time period of' takes the genitive case.

reading.ru: Господь пастырь мой, я ни в чем не буду нуждаться.
reading.question: Who is the speaker's shepherd, and what does this mean?
options: The Lord is the shepherd and will provide everything
The speaker is strong and independent
God requires the speaker to work
reading.correct: The Lord is the shepherd and will provide everything
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Господь пастырь мой' and 'я ни в чем не буду нуждаться.'

reading.ru: Он покоит меня на зеленых пастбищах и водит меня к тихим водам.
reading.question: What does the shepherd do for the speaker?
options: Makes him rest on green pastures and leads him to still waters
reading.correct: Makes him rest on green pastures and leads him to still waters
reading.explain: The text describes the shepherd making the speaker rest and leading him to still waters.

reading.ru: Он душу мою оживляет и ведет меня по путям праведности ради имени своего.
reading.question: Why does the shepherd lead the speaker in paths of righteousness?
options: For the sake of God's own name
reading.correct: For the sake of God's own name
reading.explain: The text states 'ради имени своего' (for his own name's sake).

reading.ru: Пусть пойду в темноте долины смерти, не устрашусь я зла, потому что ты со мной.
reading.question: What gives the speaker courage in the valley of death?
options: The presence and protection of God
His faith in his own ability
reading.correct: The presence and protection of God
reading.explain: The speaker says 'потому что ты со мной' (because you are with me).

reading.ru: Ты приготовил мне пир на виду моих врагов, умастил мне голову маслом, и чаша моя полна.
reading.question: What images does the speaker use to describe God's provision?
options: A feast, anointing oil, and an overflowing cup
reading.correct: A feast, anointing oil, and an overflowing cup
reading.explain: The text mentions 'пир' (feast), 'маслом' (oil), and 'чаша моя полна' (cup overflowing).

reading.ru: Так благо и милость добудут со мною все дни моей жизни, и пребуду я в доме Господнем многие дни.
reading.question: What is the speaker's confidence about the future?
options: He will become rich and powerful
Goodness and mercy will follow him and he will live in God's house forever
He will become a great leader
reading.correct: Goodness and mercy will follow him and he will live in God's house forever
reading.explain: The text states that goodness and mercy will follow him all his life and he will dwell in God's house.
